Bill 140 - Building Ontario Faster Act, 2026, 2026-18-Council Members
1.
Bill 140 - Building Ontario Faster Act, 2026 - 2026-18-Council Members.pdf
Moved By:  Carilyne Hébert, Councillor
Seconded By:  Sarah Good, Councillor
WHEREAS
:
T
he Province of Ontario has introduced Bill 140, the Building Ontario Faster Act, 2026, which proposes amendments to several pieces of environmental legislation, including the Environmental Assessment Act and
...
EREFORE BE IT RESOLVED
:
That the Council of the City of Cornwall:
Express its concerns regarding the proposed removal of municipal support requirements for new large landfill developments and the proposed elimination of existing environmental accountability mechanisms under Bill 140;
Request that the Province retain meaningful municipal decision-making authority and public participation rights in environmental approval processes;
Request that the Province reconsider the proposed amendments to the Environmental Bill of Rights that would eliminate applications for review, applications for investigation and certain appeal rights;
Direct that this resolution be forwarded to the Premier of Ontario, the Minister of the Environment, Conservation and Parks, the Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing, local Members of Provincial Parliament, and the Association of Municipalities of Ontario.
